name: Install pinned settings checker
run:
set -euo pipefail
bun_version=1.4.2
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) bun_arch=x64; bun_sha=36368faef7527875d5ffa52e53cd48021741f2a83eb6208a8dd64068d422a913 ;;
  aarch64) bun_arch=aarch64; bun_sha=54328bbc2d9c8e0c9f892c544d66c57a83b84139e34909e5ee81758f1ac8fda7 ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::No pinned Bun binary for runner architecture $(uname -m)"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
bun_archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/bun.zip"
bun_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/standards-bin"
curl -sfLo "$bun_archive" "https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v${bun_version}/bun-linux-${bun_arch}.zip"
echo "$bun_sha  $bun_archive" | sha256sum --check --quiet
mkdir "$bun_root"
unzip -q "$bun_archive" -d "$bun_root"
install -m 0755 "$bun_root/bun-linux-${bun_arch}/bun" "$bun_root/bun"

standards_version=0.21.0
standards_sha=afb8576434e62730e06d30d8249b1d275f586a874826ad7b50fe5e4d1b32b0da0e4adea176c6151160fc50a8ac049bab91095d18867b2a2544f40408f9e8f8ff
standards_archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/standards.tgz"
cli_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/standards-cli"
mkdir -p "$cli_root/package"
curl -sfLo "$standards_archive" "https://registry.npmjs.org/@davidvornholt/standards/-/standards-${standards_version}.tgz"
echo "$standards_sha  $standards_archive" | sha512sum --check --quiet
tar -xzf "$standards_archive" -C "$cli_root/package" --strip-components=1

yaml_version=2.9.1
yaml_sha=dcdc4df3eefc39dcdb4fb0bf5a31acc9f3c0b4968ddc5343b16c6fed8ee6703b13fe83a6816f01a72410145067bd91378fd63649dcf550b14b7b32fb11bdb217
yaml_archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/yaml.tgz"
mkdir -p "$cli_root/node_modules/yaml"
curl -sfLo "$yaml_archive" "https://registry.npmjs.org/yaml/-/yaml-${yaml_version}.tgz"
echo "$yaml_sha  $yaml_archive" | sha512sum --check --quiet
tar -xzf "$yaml_archive" -C "$cli_root/node_modules/yaml" --strip-components=1

name: Check GitHub settings
run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -z "$SETTINGS_TOKEN" ] || [[ "$SETTINGS_TOKEN" == *$'\n'* ]] || [[ "$SETTINGS_TOKEN" == *$'\r'* ]]; then
  echo "::error::Resolved GitHub settings token must be non-empty and single-line"
  exit 1
fi
cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/standards-cli"
GH_TOKEN="$SETTINGS_TOKEN" "$RUNNER_TEMP/standards-bin/bun" \
  package/src/cli.ts github --check --dir "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

name: Require all standards gates
run:
case "$IS_SOURCE_REPOSITORY" in
  true)
    expected_nix_result=success
    ;;
  false)
    expected_nix_result=skipped
    ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::Unexpected source-repository mode (is-source-repository=$IS_SOURCE_REPOSITORY)"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
if [ "$QUALITY_RESULT" != success ]; then
  echo "::error::Standards gates did not all succeed (quality=$QUALITY_RESULT, nix-discovery=$NIX_DISCOVERY_RESULT, nix=$NIX_RESULT)"
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$NIX_DISCOVERY_RESULT" != "$expected_nix_result" ] || [ "$NIX_RESULT" != "$expected_nix_result" ]; then
  echo "::error::Nix gates did not match the repository mode (is-source-repository=$IS_SOURCE_REPOSITORY, expected=$expected_nix_result, nix-discovery=$NIX_DISCOVERY_RESULT, nix=$NIX_RESULT)"
  exit 1
fi
